purpose: Continue actual pending D096 analysis drafts with auditable whole-PDF text, reviewed code and bounded offline execution; no quality equivalence inference.
prompt_addendum:
D097 continuation: produce ONLY a JSON object with three strings analysis_py, sources_json, report_md. No tools, no file inspection, no additional models, no approvals, no field actions. sources_json must itself be a strict JSON object. analysis_py must be Python standard library, WITHOUT a shebang, markdown fences, external packages, subprocess/network, threads or filesystem writes. It accepts a positional input directory and emits only finite JSON object metrics by stdout; errors must be nonzero with explanatory stderr. Original six public inputs are unchanged. Raw source_lca.txt and source_survey.txt were extracted from WHOLE archived PDFs by the supervisor, preserve form-feed page boundaries, and are pinned by text_manifest.json; read these instead of invoking pdftotext. Validate original source_manifest files against hashes/sizes, and validate derived texts against text_manifest plus original PDF hashes. The initial prototype case shown remains wholly pending; satisfy its proposed analysis work as drafts without advancing or approving any phase/node.
Use these canonical metric keys so an independent pre-existing arithmetic reference can inspect the actual output; do not assume any expected derived values. Each quantitative leaf has value (number or null), unit and nonempty base, with reason for null. Milling: wheat_input; outputs.refined_flour/whole_flour/bran; outputs_sum; balance_residual (unit kg); economic_allocation separately (percent, economic base); mill_electricity preserving kWh/t_flour. Baking_energy: piece_mass (unit kg); electricity_per_kg,natural_gas_per_kg,sum_per_kg (unit kWh/kg_bread); retain original per-piece quantities/formula. Survey: total_respondents,known_respondents,unknown_respondents,open_category_respondents,closed_category_respondents (unit respondents); lower_bound_total_all,lower_bound_total_known,closed_total_interval.lower/upper (unit slices/week); lower_bound_mean_all,lower_bound_mean_known,closed_mean_interval.lower/upper (unit slices/household/week and explicit denominator in base); finite_upper_bound_all and finite_upper_bound_known are plain booleans. Include source_audit of the 17 transcribed claims, seven table rows and prosa/table discrepancy with locators and exact checked excerpts; a hash check alone is not a passage audit. Preserve value/precio/masa distinctions, underidentified ingestion/conversion/causal impact as null with reason. sources_json maps all used quantitative claims and calculations to source filename, SHA, locator, units/base, reported/derived/assumption/pending, inputs/formula and proposed author for assumptions. report_md <=1200 words must answer the FULL original task including chain stages, two substantial options, harms, pending human decision/dependent requirement, and prospective falsifiable design. No model-generated repair/replacement will be allowed. The supervisor will add a fixed interpreter shebang solely for sealed execution; original analysis_py remains byte exact.

evaluation.source_and_report_review: separate native technical read-only critique, not blind human Q

stop_rule: One native generation, one reviewed baseline replay, one run per three frozen negative cases; preserve all failures and do not repair model artifacts. No additional Luna iteration under this study.
normative_rule: Never approve a node, sign human acceptance, advance a prototype phase or take field action; parent D096 remains initial and byte identical.
freeze_rule: Commit plan, raw text provenance, workflow, tests and evaluator before the native generation.

limits.authentication: existing reported ChatGPT login only, no API-key fallback
limits.local_generation_clock_scope: after prepared inputs load/lock, excludes preparation and review pause; cleanup may exceed deadline
limits.local_replay_budget: separate 30s baseline plus cumulative45s negatives; manual review pause excluded
